title: Tales of Japan with a Ryokan Night
alt: Tatami room with futons laid out in a Kyoto ryokan
transport: Bullet train, private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.subtitle: Tokyo to Mount Fuji and Disneyland
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Super deluxe room · 4★ · Four star hotel in Shinjuku, a short walk from the station

activities.name: Tokyo sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day from the LOVE statue in Shinjuku through Meiji shrine, the Imperial Palace gardens and the temple lanes of Asakusa.

activities.name: Mount Fuji, Hakone and Gotemba outlets
activities.match: Trip to Mt Fuji 5th Station, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets
activities.description: The fifth station on Mount Fuji, Lake Ashi in Hakone and a shopping stop at the Gotemba outlets on the way back.

activities.name: Tokyo Disneyland
activities.description: A full day at Tokyo Disneyland with your admission tickets included, so you can be at the gates when the park opens.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Four nights in Shinjuku with a guided city day, Mount Fuji with the Gotemba outlets and a full day at Disneyland.

stops.name: Kyoto
stops.subtitle: Kyoto to Nara and Arashiyama
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Deluxe room · 3★ · Small ryokan in the Gion lanes, tatami rooms and a shared bath

activities.name: Kyoto, Nara and Arashiyama
activities.description: Kinkaku-ji and the deer park at Nara, then the bamboo grove at Arashiyama with a ride on the open sided Sagano scenic train.

program.name: Kyoto
program.description: Two ryokan nights in the Gion lanes, with a quiet arrival day and a full day through Kyoto, Nara and Arashiyama.

stops.name: Osaka
stops.subtitle: Osaka to Nabana no Sato and Universal Studios
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel opposite Shin-Osaka station, handy for the trains

activities.name: Sakura Magic and Nabana no Sato illumination
activities.match: Sakura Magic & Nabana no Sato Tour
activities.description: Blossom gardens by day and then Nabana no Sato after dark, where millions of lights are strung into tunnels and fields.

activities.name: Universal Studios Japan
activities.description: A full day at Universal Studios Japan with tickets included, home to Super Nintendo World and the Harry Potter area.

program.name: Osaka
program.description: Two nights in Osaka to finish, with the Nabana no Sato lights on arrival and a full day at Universal Studios Japan.

day_titles.7: On to Osaka and the illuminations

1: Arrival at Narita or Haneda and transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Shinjuku hotel
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: the Tokyo Metropolitan Building viewing decks, free of charge
2: Breakfast, then a guided day through the city
Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens
Asakusa and the Senso-ji temple lanes
3: Breakfast, then out of the city towards Mount Fuji
The fifth station on the mountain, weather permitting
Lake Ashi and the Hakone viewpoints
A shopping stop at the Gotemba outlets
4: Early breakfast, then across to Tokyo Disneyland
Admission tickets included for the full day
5: Breakfast and check out, then transfer to the station
Check in at your ryokan in Gion
Futons, tatami and a soak in the shared bath
6: Breakfast, then a full day out with your guide
Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, on its pond
The deer park and Todai-ji temple in Nara
The bamboo grove and Sagano scenic train at Arashiyama
7: Breakfast and check out, then on towards Osaka
The blossom gardens in the afternoon
Nabana no Sato and its light tunnels after dark
8: Early breakfast, then across to Universal Studios Japan
Tickets included for the full day
Super Nintendo World and the Harry Potter area
9: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Kansai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: A ryokan in the middle of a family trip is the memory that sticks. Futons on the floor beat any hotel bed at that age.
expert.tip: The Gion ryokan has a shared bath, so go early in the evening when it is quiet. Slippers on, phones away, it is part of the fun.

summary: Nine days through three cities: four nights in Shinjuku with a city day, Mount Fuji and Tokyo Disneyland, two ryokan nights in the Gion lanes with Kyoto, Nara and Arashiyama, then two in Osaka with the Nabana no Sato lights and Universal Studios Japan.
included: Included: 8 nights with breakfast on most mornings, including two ryokan nights in Kyoto; bullet trains between Tokyo, Kyoto and Osaka; private airport transfers; Tokyo sightseeing tour; Mount Fuji fifth station with Hakone and the Gotemba outlets; Tokyo Disneyland tickets; Kyoto and Nara tour with Arashiyama and the Sagano train; Sakura Magic and Nabana no Sato tour; Universal Studios Japan tickets.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
